pages.title: Synaptic Fluid
pages.text: A warm, conductive medium for photonic thought. It carries signals between photonic neurons with almost no loss and stays at body temperature on its own. It glows softly when a thought passes through.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Condensing photonic neurons with superfluid helium, I found the neurons dissolved into a fluid that still carried their signals. The neural network had become a liquid.
